column1: One row per holdout task: `task <stable task id>`. The base/head world ids are
the mechanical archive names `<task>-base` / `<task>-head`, and the exact
revisions are read from the declared holdout archive identity record
(`//test/reviewbench_pilot:holdout-archives.tsv`), so no revision, world or gold
is restated here. The 24 task ids are the frozen holdout selection drawn from the
remaining fast cohort and EXCLUDE every original24 task; no pilot task is present.
